title: Gazebo Worlds (PX4 Guide)
summary: Lists the gz worlds PX4 ships for SITL and how to select one, alongside the vehicle models such as x500_depth and x500_lidar_2d.
key_takeaways: Obstacle-type worlds exist (walls, forest)
World and model are picked at launch time

title: macOS Development Environment (PX4 Guide)
summary: Native macOS setup for PX4 SITL with Gazebo Harmonic via Tools/setup/macos.sh --sim-tools, which pulls gz from a locked conda-forge env through pixi.
key_takeaways: Works on Apple Silicon; CI runs on Apple Silicon only
Raise ulimit to 2048 or the link step fails
Installs XQuartz and trusts third-party Homebrew taps

title: VOXL Vision Obstacle Avoidance (VOA)
summary: How voxl-vision-hub turns stereo depth into OBSTACLE_DISTANCE messages for PX4 or ArduPilot collision prevention on VOXL boards.
key_takeaways: Disabled by default; enable en_voa and the DFS server
Stereo is the documented input; ToF is community-only
Still needs PX4 Collision Prevention params

title: Sphinx system requirements
summary: Hardware and OS requirements for Parrot's Sphinx drone simulator.
key_takeaways: NVIDIA GPU required (2 GB min, RTX 2070 recommended)
Not usable on an Apple Silicon Mac

title: LSY Autonomous Drone Racing documentation
authors: Learning Systems and Robotics Lab, TUM
summary: Course docs for the Crazyflie gates-and-obstacles racing challenge: setup, difficulty levels, sim and real deployment.
key_takeaways: Competition runs at level 2: randomized inertia and obstacle/gate positions
Same controller interface in sim and on hardware

title: Multi-ranger deck
summary: Crazyflie expansion deck with five VL53L1x ToF sensors (front, back, left, right, up) measuring up to about 4 m.
key_takeaways: Five-direction range scan, no forward camera needed
Pair with the Flow deck for position hold

title: Flow deck v2
summary: Crazyflie deck combining a PMW3901 optical flow sensor and a VL53L1x height sensor, fused in the onboard EKF for indoor position hold without external infrastructure.
key_takeaways: Height up to about 4 m
Works best on matte, textured floors
Drift grows with distance flown

title: Virtual Stick Sample (DJI MSDK V5)
summary: DJI tutorial for driving an aircraft from an Android app with virtual stick and advanced virtual stick parameters.
key_takeaways: Enable advanced mode before sendVirtualStickAdvancedParam
Not available during waypoint missions or RTH

title: Tello SDK 2.0 User Guide
summary: The UDP text command set for Tello EDU: control, set and read commands, mission pad commands and state stream format.
key_takeaways: go x y z speed in cm, +-500, 10-100 cm/s
rc a b c d gives stick-level control without ack
Auto-land after 15 s without a command

title: Challenges and implemented technologies used in autonomous drone racing
summary: Organisers and teams review the IROS 2016 and 2017 autonomous drone races: the indoor gate format and the localisation, gate detection and control methods teams used.
key_takeaways: Indoor gate course with onboard sensing
Teams used modified ORB-SLAM, sensor fusion, CNN and stereo gate detection
Localisation was the hard part

title: AirSim Drone Racing Lab
summary: Describes the AirSim-based framework and the NeurIPS 2019 Game of Drones simulation competition with perception, planning/control and head-to-head tiers.
key_takeaways: Tiered tasks separate perception from planning and control
117 teams registered, 16 unique entries reached submission

title: IMAV 2026 Competition Rules for Indoor and Outdoor Competitions
summary: Rulebook for the International Micro Air Vehicle competition 2026: indoor net arena with an obstacle course, dark-room inspection, payload drop, turbine inspection and precision landing, with detailed scoring.
key_takeaways: Autonomy factor: 1.0 onboard, 0.7 off-board compute or beacons, 0.4 manual intervention
Mass factor 1.13 (3 kg) to 2.0 (0.1 kg)
Risk-graded points: smaller window and harder bar score more
Landing bonus on a static or moving ArUco platform

title: Learning High-Speed Flight in the Wild
summary: A network trained only in simulation by imitating a privileged planner maps onboard depth and state to collision-free trajectories, flown fast in forests and ruins (Science Robotics 2021).
key_takeaways: Privileged-expert imitation transfers sim to real
Depth plus state is enough for fast obstacle flight

title: crazyflie-simulation documentation
summary: Docs for Bitcraze's Crazyflie simulation options in Webots and Gazebo, with install guides and a Webots wall-following demo.
key_takeaways: Two backends: Webots and Gazebo
Wall-following demo uses simulated range sensing
